description: Describe the screen or feature you're building; get the Candor UI items that fit, why, the matching patterns and screens, and an install command per tier. When nothing in Candor fits, it says so rather than suggesting something close. Pass `sdk` so only your agent SDK's adapter is suggested. Read each suggestion's docs before using it.

sdk.description: The agent SDK the app uses: ai-sdk (the Vercel AI SDK), claude (the Claude Agent SDK) or ag-ui. Only that SDK's adapter and block versions are suggested. Leave it out and no adapter is installed; the answer says which to add.

task.description: What you're building, e.g. "a chat where the agent asks before deploying".

tier.description: Only suggest what this tier unlocks. Leave it out to see everything, with tiers marked.

name: suggest_components
title: Suggest Candor UI components for a task
